summary: Receipt Evidence Bundle turns caller-verified runx receipts into a redacted, reviewer-safe packet that separates proven facts, bounded lineage inferences, missing evidence, and replayable reviewer actions.

observations.claim: The supported CLI used for verification is runx-cli 0.6.13.
The package owner is the GitHub publisher zdfgu113.
observations.evidence: The source branch is hosted in zdfgu113/runx.

observations.claim: The package name and version are receipt-evidence-bundle 0.1.0.
observations.evidence: SKILL.md and X.yaml declare the same package identity.

observations.claim: The harness contains three executable cases.
observations.evidence: references/harness.json records case_count 3 and status passed.
The malformed-reference-is-refused harness case passed with the expected failure receipt.
The unverifiable-receipt-is-refused harness case passed with the expected failure receipt.

observations.claim: A valid parent-child input produces a sealed evidence bundle.
observations.evidence: The valid-parent-child-bundle harness case passed and produced a signed receipt.

observations.claim: The runner recursively redacts secret-bearing fields.
observations.evidence: The valid harness input includes a bearer token under bearer_token; the runner replaces sensitive-key values before fact extraction.

observations.claim: The dogfood receipt is cryptographically valid.
observations.evidence: references/verification.json records valid true with no findings.

observations.claim: The implementation, execution profile, harness output, dogfood receipt, verification result, and reviewer report are public-source artifacts.
observations.evidence: They are stored together under skills/receipt-evidence-bundle in the source branch.
